visual_brief.subject: Gemini 4 Argon exposes a very large unified token envelope that must pass through a controlled production output path
verified_context: Google released Gemini 4 Argon as a stable API model with a unified 1,048,576-token input-and-output budget.
Normal synchronous output is capped at 65,536 tokens, while an optional long-decode path can use the full unified budget.
The model's vendor-reported coding results are strong but vary materially across benchmarks.
visual_brief.editorial_idea: A vast reasoning capacity is useful only when it is deliberately narrowed into a controlled, reviewable production artifact.
visual_brief.visual_metaphor: A monumental folded paper chamber holds an immense field of fine branching paths, all converging through one precise stone aperture into a restrained terracotta ribbon, giving scale and control physical presence without a diagram.

candidate_notes.A: Selected. A monumental folded paper chamber gives the token envelope physical scale while thousands of fine paths converge through one stone aperture into a single terracotta output ribbon.
candidate_notes.B: Constitution-compliant. The terraced amphitheater is spacious and strongly cropped, but the tiny aperture makes the production boundary less legible at thumbnail scale.
candidate_notes.C: Constitution-compliant. The suspended paper roll has a clear silhouette, but the cylindrical form is more literal and less spatially confident than candidate A.

crop_review.article_desktop: The full chamber, convergence aperture, and output ribbon remain visible in the 1600 x 900 crop.
crop_review.article_mobile: A centered narrow crop retains the converging paths and aperture as the main relationship.
crop_review.thumbnail: The folded chamber and terracotta ribbon remain distinct at 480 x 270 without requiring the fine paths.

golden_reference_comparison: The selected image matches the production references' warm paper ground, restrained charcoal and terracotta palette, fine-line texture, large physical forms, and calm negative space while using a new folded-volume silhouette.
